instructions_to_main_agent: Upgrade all UI components to match the Awwwards-level Dark Cyber-Fintech & Gold Glassmorphism design guidelines.
Retain all existing data-testid attributes and exact component names/state logics.
Ensure mobile layout stays bounded inside max-w-[480px] centered on desktop screens.
Use Framer Motion for wheel spin, modals, tab switching, and code ticket list stagger animations.
Inject subtle particle glows, ticket side notches, and angled clipping edges using SVG/CSS clip-path.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add text-align: center globally.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like transition: all, as it breaks transforms. Always target specific properties.
Never use generic transparent backgrounds in headers, dropdowns, or overlays; always use glassmorphism with backdrop blur.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Only use official local assets or specified Unsplash URLs.
